content: Service Name Bmc_FetchXor_s Syntax Bmc_AtomicSType Bmc_FetchXor_s ( volatile Bmc_AtomicSType * Object, Bmc_AtomicSType Operand ) Service ID [hex] 0x84 to 0x87 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Operand Value for the operation Parameters (inout) Object Object Parameters (out) None Return value Bmc_AtomicSType The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects Description Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the result of the xor-operation applied to the value pointed to by Object and the given Operand. Available via Bmc.h
